properties.notes: The site is located within the built confines of Noah’s Ark, although this settlement does not have a boundary and is washed over by the Green Belt. The existing access onto Noah’s Ark could be utilised. The site lies within the AONB however redevelopment of the site could contribute towards improving the character. Overall the site is considered able to accommodate development, subject to the retention or reprovision of the employment floorspace, however it is located within the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
